newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Niagara Mowhawk rating change.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Niagara Mowhawk rating change.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Friday it changed its rating on Niagara Mowhawk Power Corp to neutral from outperform (speculative) based on the company's decision yesterday to delay declaration of a preferred dividend.
-- Gruntal said a major factor in the move was also the price of the stock, which has appreciated 42 percent since March 1996.

-- The company believes there will be a decision on purchase power contract negotiations in the short term, Gruntal said, which would have a significant impact on its books when they close for the year sometime before April 15.
-- Gruntal believes the preferred dividend delay is intended to increase the pressure on the parties in the purchase power talks.
-- Niagara Mowhawk markets electric energy and natural gas. Its shares closed down 3/8 Friday at 10-1/8.
